svg.title: AREA 40
svg.desc: The Force collects the first-room boxes. After the paired four-weapon switches, the strongest player takes the southern solo route and the others north. The split route needs two players: use 2→2′, activate the switch, then 3→3′; do not press the center pad. Ignore the large-hall warp and the healing ring behind the MAG door.
